content: {"episode_id":"ep-05049","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, which the payer states was denied because prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome (I49.5) and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9). Per the note, given the paroxysmal nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture and characterize the arrhythmic events. We therefore request reconsideration of the denied balance of 628.86 based on this documented medical necessity."}
